question.worked_solution:
First, note that $n=0$ cannot be a solution since division by $0$ is undefined.

To solve the equation, we move the negative sign onto the numerator of the fraction and then apply cross-multiplication:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{12}{7} & =-\frac{4}{3n} \\ \frac{12}{7} & =\frac{-4}{3n} \\ 12\cdot 3n & =7\cdot (-4) \\ 36n & =-28\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the multiplication principle:

$$
\begin{aligned}36n & =-28 \\ n & =-\frac{28}{36} \\ n & =-\frac{28÷4}{36÷4} \\ n & =-\frac{7}{9}\end{aligned}
$$

Since  $n=-\frac{7}{9}$ is different from $n=0,$ we can accept it as a solution. Therefore, the solution is $n=-\frac{7}{9}.$
